scope: Standalone corrected-home HTML served once over permitted local HTTP. All subsequent network access blocked; actual theme CSS/JavaScript runs with explicit neutral local product/article/photo fixtures.

fileProtocol.reason: Previous managed Chromium file:// check returned net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR; browser policy has not been changed or bypassed. This artifact was tested by one HTTP document load with zero subsequent dependencies.

The source theme includes no actual garment photos; native branding chapters show the actual no-image state, while product/article images are neutral labelled fixtures.
